security.zeroization: KMIPKit-owned secret-bearing TTLV values follow the existing TTLV zeroization contract. Secret-bearing encoded request bytes remain in the existing zeroizing owner through transport completion and are zeroized on drop. Registry declarations and diagnostics never contain extension payload bytes.

runtimeCopies.c: C input spans are borrowed for the call. KMIPKit-owned extension handles follow the zeroization contract; caller-owned copies remain outside it.
runtimeCopies.java: Java byte arrays and objects are runtime-owned copies and may outlive native handles; they are outside KMIPKit zeroization guarantees.
runtimeCopies.python: Python bytes and objects are runtime-owned copies and may outlive native handles; they are outside KMIPKit zeroization guarantees.
